description: Asynchronous Rust library, with Python and Node.js bindings, that moves messages and data between brokers, databases, object storage, files and HTTP.
rules: Use the docs of the version in Cargo.lock. The crate ships llms.txt and docs/ for its exact version.
Take field names from docs/REFERENCE.md or `mqb describe <name> --json`. Do not infer them from models.rs.
Connectors are Cargo features. Only `file` and `dir-spool` are enabled by default.
StreamCaller and docs/HANDLERS.md require mq-bridge 1.7.0 or later.
